question: Which company topped the Hurun Global 1000 Report 2025 to become the world’s most valuable company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nvidia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Nvidia emerged as the world’s most valuable company in the Hurun Global 1000 Report 2025, overtaking Microsoft and Apple.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Hurun Global 1000 Report 2025 ranks the world’s 1,000 most valuable companies**, expanding from the earlier Global 500 list.
 
• **Nvidia topped the rankings**, reflecting its sharp rise in market valuation.
 
• **The surge is driven by explosive demand for AI chips and computing power**, where Nvidia holds a dominant position.
 
• **The rankings highlight how AI-led innovation is reshaping global corporate leadership** and economic influence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Hurun Global 1000** is an annual ranking that measures companies based on market capitalisation and enterprise value.
 
• **Nvidia** is a US-based technology company specialising in graphics processing units (GPUs) and AI hardware.
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** refers to computer systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as learning and decision-making.
 
• **AI chip dominance** has become a critical factor in determining corporate valuation due to rising demand from data centres, cloud computing, and advanced technologies.
